entries.hypothesis: Inside the production dual-batch walker, the two batches' rounds alternate at round granularity (G = 1). Coarser alternation blocks (G = 2, 4, 8 rounds of one batch before switching) trade latency hiding against instruction-cache and register locality; a coarser point may measure better than the production point through the real search path (portfolio NOVA-ER-0014, register Y-043). The portfolio prior, by analogy with EXP-005's flat geometry curve on the SHA-NI family, is that the curve is flat near the production point.
entries.baseline: Production dual-batch walker bal_vd_search2 (.local/cpu/libbal_v512dual.so, from mining/cpu/bal_avx512_dual.c): inside the dual compress, the two batches' rounds alternate at round granularity (A round t, B round t), G = 1. No round work is added or removed at any granularity point, so there is no arithmetic ceiling; any effect is a second-order scheduling effect (latency hiding, spill and instruction-cache behaviour).
